title: TransparencyArtifact
description: Mandatory explanation of a non-GLM model. Fitting a black box is allowed; pricing with an unexplained one is not (02 R3, FR-MODEL-33..37, §4.9).
$comment: Amended 2026-08-22 (W5, the contract-reconciliation slice). Six resolutions, each the code's (CLAUDE.md §0): (1) `kinds` is deleted — it is a derived `@property` on `TransparencyArtifact`, never stored, which is how §4.9's invariant is made unable to be violated; §4.10's own amendment records that it 'reached the same conclusion and became a plain property'. (2) `id`, `created_at` and `job_id` are declared; the first two are required and this contract named neither. (3) `approximating_model_id` leaves `required`: FR-MODEL-96 makes it exclusive with the inline table, so requiring it unconditionally invalidated every artifact written before 2026-08-19. (4) `r_squared` and `deviance_explained` lose `minimum: 0`, which the type deliberately does not apply — a fit can be worse than the mean, and clamping a negative R² would report a useless approximation as a mediocre one. (5) `relativity_table_blob` and `dependence_blob` are BlobRefs, not strings; §4.9's example still shows the pre-BlobRef `blob:sha256:…` spelling. (6) the GLM approximation's own `family`, `link`, `coefficients` and `relativities` are declared — the last two are FR-MODEL-96's legacy era, and a reader deciding whether an old artifact is still readable had no way to see them here.

job_id.description: The job that produced this artifact, where one did.

glm_approximation.description: A GLM fitted to the GBM's own predictions — what turns a GBM into something rateable as a table (FR-MODEL-34).

approximating_model_id.description: FR-MODEL-96 — the Model that holds the approximation's table. Set on every artifact written from 2026-08-19; null on artifacts written before, which carry the table inline instead. Exactly one of the two, never both and never neither.

r_squared.description: Bounded above by 1 and deliberately not below: a fit can be worse than the mean.

coefficients.description: LEGACY ERA. Populated only on artifacts written before FR-MODEL-96 was built (2026-08-19), where the table had nowhere else to live. New artifacts name a Model and leave this empty.

relativities.description: LEGACY ERA, exclusive with `approximating_model_id` exactly as `coefficients` is.

worst_regions.description: Where the approximation is worst, and over how much of the book (FR-MODEL-36). The exposure share is required: '11 % out for young high-mileage drivers' is a different sentence at 0.8 % of exposure than at 8 %.

shap_summary.description: FR-MODEL-35; computed on a reproducible sample with a persisted seed.

algorithm.description: UNRECONCILED (W5, 2026-08-22): this contract has always declared a closed set — tree_shap, tree_shap_interventional, kernel_shap — and `ShapSummary.algorithm` is an unconstrained `str` defaulting to `tree_shap`. Widened to `string` so the published contract does not promise a constraint nothing enforces; whether the type should close instead is a CLAUDE.md §0 question.

mean_abs_contribution.description: Mean |contribution| on the raw score scale, exposure-weighted (FR-MODEL-35).

top_interactions.description: A suggestion, never an addition (FR-MODEL-79): an interaction becomes rateable only as an explicit `interaction` Factor carrying an intent and a written rationale.

interactions_available.description: False on LightGBM, which computes SHAP values and not SHAP interaction values. `top_interactions` is then empty rather than absent, because a missing list reads as 'no interactions found' — a finding this backend cannot make.

ebm_shape_functions.description: EBMs are transparent by construction; their term shape functions export directly as rateable tables (FR-MODEL-37). Amended 2026-08-22 (W5, EBM slice): `terms_blob` is non-empty, mirroring `EbmShapeFunctions.terms_blob`'s `min_length=1`.

fidelity_statement.description: How well the approximation reproduces the model, WHERE it does not, and the exposure share of that region. Surfaced at rating-version approval (FR-MODEL-36).

monotonicity_verified.description: FR-MODEL-52's monotonicity check, carried upward. Null where the model declared no constrained factor — distinct from false, which would say a constraint was checked and failed.

invariants: at least one of glm_approximation, shap_summary, ebm_shape_functions is present (FR-MODEL-33) — an artifact with no block is a fidelity statement about nothing, and it would satisfy R3
glm_approximation carries exactly one table: approximating_model_id, or the inline coefficients/relativities of an artifact written before 2026-08-19 (FR-MODEL-96)
a non-GLM Model cannot reach approved without this artifact (02 R3, FR-MODEL-89)
